spec_classes.no_legal_xy_corridor: 目标高度上找不到满足严格 D56 / R15 / 引线约束的平面 XY 路径
spec_classes.target_height_occupied: 目标物理高度已被其它 body 线路占用（同高度 D56 无法放置）
spec_classes.r15_geometry_rejected: R15 几何原语无法组装（圆弧 / 双弧 S 过渡 / 引线几何被拒）
spec_classes.transition_3d_conflict: 三维 S 过渡与其它层线路 / 过渡的 3D 中心线净空 < 0.05 mm
spec_classes.lead_below_minimum: 端口引线长度低于下限，路线几何不可用
spec_classes.joint_rebuild_failed: 联合事务（多线 rip+plan+place）无法全体同时合法，整体回滚
spec_classes.legal_but_no_crossing_improvement: 候选几何合法但没有降低同层交叉（不满足 min_gain，拒绝进入接受流）
spec_classes.budget_exhausted: 达到 route_3d_checks / d56_candidate_evals / 墙钟预算上限而停止
spec_classes.no_current_crossings: 目标线路当前没有交叉，无需优化
spec_classes.structure_error: 状态 / 接口 / 数据结构异常导致尝试失败
spec_classes.unclassified: 未归类的失败原因（保留原始 key，不丢弃）

d56_candidate_evals_proxy.name: d56_index_evaluate_calls_proxy
d56_candidate_evals_proxy.definition: observed four_side_1024.d56.index.D56Index.evaluate invocations during the C0 search
d56_candidate_evals_proxy.why: the legacy G3 engine does not book its exact strict-D56 candidate evaluations in the shared Ledger, so the SPEC main counter is null; this proxy uses a different counting convention than the G4 ledger (d56_top per plan_candidates call) and is therefore NOT used as a fair-budget axis

extras.route_3d_checks_definition: RouteWorld.evaluate_candidate calls (one full true-3D World geometric check of one candidate route each)
extras.rng_note: legacy optimizer is deterministic: the seed is recorded as a contract field but the engine consumes no RNG
extras.note: C0 only accepts strictly improving single-route changes (min_delta=1), so the final state is the arm best state
